text.description_html:
DWD-BDS350U15, 3-1/2" Contemporary Satin Nickel Door Stop

Not only does this contemporary Satin Nickel door stop look great, it is made to last from Solid Brass. It is easy to install; just screw onto the baseboard casement or door bottom and it will protect your doors, walls, knobs or levers. It includes both gray and white rubber tips and installation screw.

Specifications for the DWD-BDS350U15 Contemporary Satin Nickel Door Stop:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Length: 3-1/2"
  • Diameter: 5/8"
  • Rubber Bumper Tips: Gray and White Tips included
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Packaged with mounting hardware.
  • DWD-BDS350 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only 275 Left.
